summary: Implemented Pydantic v2 domain schemas (TodoStatus, TodoPriority, TodoCreate, TodoUpdate, TodoItem, TodoStats) and SQLite WAL persistence layer (TodoStore) fulfilling TSK-01 and DEC-01 architecture requirements.

acceptance_criteria_verification.rejects_empty_titles_and_nonpositive_hou: Pydantic v2 field_validator enforces non-empty, stripped titles and Field(..., gt=0) rejects expected_hours <= 0 with validation errors.
acceptance_criteria_verification.sqlite_wal_persistence: TodoStore enforces PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL and PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL, persisting todos across fresh store reinstantiations and server restarts.
acceptance_criteria_verification.aggregate_stats_computation: aggregate_stats() computes exact task counts and expected_hours grouped by status (pending, working, incomplete, completed) and priority tiers, specifically isolating MVP task counts and MVP expected hours.
